subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers treat the open conflicting fork candidate at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/930 as adoptable source work, or clear that path and allow a fresh narrow Feishu-only repair for this issue?
rationale: The source-level defect and fix boundary are clear, but an open conflicting fork PR still claims the issue while the same head was already rejected in the target repo as broad and unmergeable.

options.title: Clear fork and queue a narrow repair
options.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable for landing and allow a focused Feishu fetched-message mention fix with tests and live proof.

options.title: Adopt and narrow the fork
options.body: Use only the fetched-message mention parser idea from the fork candidate and discard unrelated branch changes before review.

options.title: Leave owner-driven
options.body: Keep the issue open for Feishu owners to implement with live workspace proof when ready.

recommendation.title: Clear fork and queue a narrow repair
recommendation.body: Treat the conflicting fork branch as non-viable for landing and allow a focused Feishu fetched-message mention fix with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is confined to the declared Feishu/Lark plugin boundary and its fetched-message context behavior.
